facts.title: three-bean chili
ingredients: 1 to 2 peppers of your choice (see Notes, below), finely chopped
1 1/2 teaspoons table salt or 2 1/2 teaspoons kosher or coarse salt
1 28-ounce can crushed tomatoes, fire-roasted if you can find them
facts.yield_text: Yield: About 9 cups chili; 8 smaller servings or 4 to 6 large ones
facts.author: Deb Perelman
